items.title: Scalable Quantum Error Correction with Surface Code on a 2D Qubit Array
items.summary: We demonstrate a practical implementation of surface code error correction on a 72-qubit superconducting processor, achieving a logical error rate below the break-even threshold.

items.title: Neuromorphic Computing with Phase-Change Memristor Crossbar Arrays
items.summary: A novel phase-change memristor design enables 8-bit precision analog computation in crossbar arrays, achieving 100x energy efficiency improvement over digital accelerators for inference tasks.

items.title: 国内首条量子芯片产线投产，年产能突破万片
items.summary: 国内首条量子计算芯片量产产线正式投产，采用超导量子比特技术路线，标志着我国量子计算从实验室走向产业化的关键一步。

items.title: 固态电池量产在即：能量密度达500Wh/kg，续航超1000公里
items.summary: 多家企业宣布固态电池即将量产，能量密度突破500Wh/kg，预计2027年装车。这将是新能源汽车续航里程的分水岭。
